Sam (AE): Quick sync — Prospect 'Altura Health' asked about SSO + SCIM for a multi-tenant POC. Key asks: delegated admin, domain ownership proof, SCIM delta rate limits, and pricing for Dedicated vs Hosted.
Clara (Solutions Eng): Got it. Are they expecting user-level RBAC or groups-only?
Sam (AE): They want RBAC with role inheritance (org -> team -> app), plus delegated admin for tenant owners. Also asked about SCIM delta for large orgs (~200k users).
Clara (Solutions Eng): For RBAC we support role mappings via SCIM groups and our API. We'll need to call out: 1) SCIM group-to-role mapping is configurable, 2) delegated admin is supported on Dedicated & Private (hosted has constraints).
Ravi (Security): Ping — they have SOC2 + need to know SAML assertion claims we require. We should list required attributes for IdP config (email, sub/uid, groups, domain claim).
Clara (Solutions Eng): Drafting a short checklist for IdP: 
```
- Assertion subject: immutable user id (sub or uid)
- email (verified)
- groups claim (optional for SCIM-less setups)
- domain or tenant claim for domain locking when using hosted
- NameID format: email or persistent
- Signed assertions + SHA256 alg
```
Sam (AE): They also asked about proof of domain ownership workflow (can't rely on ephemeral emails).
Tori (Onboarding): For domain proofing: we accept DNS TXT verification or email to domain admin. For enterprise with strict controls recommend DNS method. Document that in the POC runbook.
Sam (AE): SCIM delta rate limit — customer expects near real-time provisioning. They asked if we support event-driven webhooks to speed up sync.
Clara (Solutions Eng): We support SCIM delta with up to X reqs/s on Hosted; Dedicated can be tuned higher. Recommend: initial full sync via bulk list (paged GET /Users) then delta via webhook + batch SCIM PATCH. For 200k users, plan full sync overnight, then delta at ~10 req/s by default. We can provide a config doc to tune batching.
Ravi (Security): Also flagged: they need JIT provisioning with just-in-time group claims for external authn flows. Does Redwood support on-the-fly role assignment when user signs in?
Clara (Solutions Eng): Yes — we resolve groups/roles at auth time if groups present in SAML, and we have a fallback to call SCIM lookup for missing mappings. Note jitter on first sign-in (KV cache miss).
Sam (AE): Pricing question from procurement: cost delta between Hosted token usage + SCIM requests vs Dedicated reserved capacity. They want headcount-neutral POC cost.
Tori (Onboarding): For POC we typically offer a short Hosted credits package (30 days) covering expected token/embedding usage. If SCIM-heavy, we include a scoping estimate for SCIM API usage; Dedicated is quoted as monthly reserved price — I can attach a sample POC SOW.
Sam (AE): Can you draft a one-pager with: SSO checklist, SCIM runbook, RBAC mapping details, and a rough cost comparison Hosted vs Dedicated? Need to send to their IdP team today.
Clara (Solutions Eng): Will do. Also adding a note about fallback policies: if SCIM rate limit hit, we fall back to cached roles and send delta retry.
DeployBot: Deployment tag: poc/altura/2026-03-23 created by Sam (AE)
Ravi (Security): Two security blockers they called out: 1) admin audit logs retention (they want 1 year), 2) KMS integration for private deploys (HSM optional). Are both supported?
Tori (Onboarding): Admin audit logs retention configurable on Dedicated/Private. Hosted has 90-day default, enterprise add-on for 1yr. KMS: Private supports customer-managed keys; Dedicated can be configured with KMS integration per contract.
Sam (AE): Perfect. Clara, can you paste the draft here once ready and I'll run it by procurement. Also include any curl snippets or IdP metadata examples.
Clara (Solutions Eng): Will post in ~45m. Quick note: ask Altura to provide a sample SAML metadata blob + SCIM base URL so we can validate assertion attributes early.
Sam (AE): Copy. I'll ask them for metadata and also try to get a sample user CSV for initial sync.
Ravi (Security): One more: they asked about tenant isolation for multi-tenant Dedicated vs Hosted. Short answer?
Clara (Solutions Eng): Dedicated = isolated GPU pools + tenant-level RBAC and VPC options. Hosted = logical isolation, stricter domain-locking required for cross-tenant admin. I'll add a clear table in the one-pager.
Sam (AE): Thanks all. Posting the follow-up to Altura now.
(ended)
